lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in three primary horizontal rows along the lateral flank. The spots exhibit a regular spacing, forming a staggered grid pattern relative to the vertical axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows. The largest circular blobs are positioned at the midpoints between these vertical bands, creating a checkerboard-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature extends from the upper branchial region to the dorsal fin base, defined by a sharp transition from high pixel intensity on the dorsal side to a deep shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, with approximately 7 distinct spots visible. These are primarily concentrated in the lower two-thirds of the fin surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal apex of the first dorsal fin displays an irregular, truncated morphology with jagged pixel edges, indicating historical tissue loss. A localized notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a high-density cluster of micro-blobs, significantly smaller than the flank spots, which transitions into an organized grid pattern posterior to the fifth gill slit.
